# Actions

## cancel_on_device_model_download

Stops downloading the model for this device.

Flags: writes on_device_model | UI-only

No input.

## create_item

Adds an item with a title and an optional description.

Flags: writes items

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | yes | The item title, 1 to 200 characters. |
| `description` | string | no | Optional details, up to 2000 characters. |

## delete_item

Deletes an item by its id.

Flags: writes items | needs approval

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | The id of the item to delete. |

Failure codes: `not_found`

## delete_items

Deletes several items by their ids with one approval. Nothing is deleted when one id does not exist.

Flags: writes items | needs approval

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ids` | array of string | yes | The ids of the items to delete. |

Failure codes: `not_found`

## delete_memory

Forgets a remembered fact by its id.

Flags: writes memories | needs approval

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | The id shown next to the memory. |

Failure codes: `not_found`

## delete_on_device_model

Deletes the model that runs on this device to free space.

Flags: writes on_device_model | UI-only

No input.

## dismiss_on_device_offer

Hides the offer to download the model for this device.

No input.

## download_on_device_model

Downloads the model that runs on this device, then loads it.

No input.

## get_item

## list_items

Lists the newest items with their ids, and the total number of items. Titles and descriptions are shortened; get_item returns the full text.

Flags: read-only

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | no | How many items to return; 50 when left out. |
